name: Master Divine God, Realm & Deity Art Direction System
purpose: Master art-direction standard for every god/Deity in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Every Deity must visually communicate: GOD + MYTHOLOGY + PERSONALITY + FACTION + REALM + GATE LORE + DIVINE POWER + COMBAT IDENTITY.

coreCreativeStandard.communication: A legendary god has entered the battlefield — NOT a fantasy warrior wearing expensive armor
coreCreativeStandard.prohibition: Do not create generic RPG characters

canonLore.sourceOfTruth: The current Mythos Gates: Ascension Codex is always the source of truth
rules: Do not revive removed lore (e.g., Mycocide)
Do not introduce factions, realms, gods, relationships, weapons, powers, or history that conflicts with current canon
If information exists in the Codex, use it
If something is not established, create only what is necessary and ensure it does not contradict existing lore

2_MYTHOLOGY.description: What mythology or legendary tradition defines them?
2_MYTHOLOGY.rule: Mythological foundation → Mythos Gates interpretation. Use authentic mythological symbolism. Do not blindly copy historical depictions.

3_FACTION.description: What faction does the god belong to?
3_FACTION.rule: Established factions must remain distinct. Do not reintroduce removed lore.

4_REALM.rule: The realm must influence the actual character design — not merely the background. A player should see the character and understand which world they come from.

5_MYTHOS_GATES.description: How is this god connected to the dimensional Gates?

realmDNA.description: Internal visual DNA profile for every established realm

globalRules: Faction identity must be visible through materials, silhouette, symbols, texture, and posture before any generic fantasy trope.
deities are living extradimensional beings, not buildings, robots, statues, block stacks, or abstract architecture piles.
NPCs are non-playable lore characters whose costume must show role, faction duty, and personal history.
Creatures can be monstrous but must stay rooted in faction or Hollow logic rather than generic alien design.
Architecture can influence clothing, regalia, auras, weapons, and environment — never replace living anatomy for character assets.
No readable real-world text or logos; glyphs and marks must be abstract lore texture.

mandatoryVisualRules.extradimensional: CRITICAL: This is an extradimensional divine being, NOT a human in costume. Colossal in scale — towering, massive, dwarfing the environment.
mandatoryVisualRules.bareHead: Head should have a deity-appropriate crown, helm, or headpiece as part of the deity's identity. No floating halos, no circular light rings behind the head. Crowns and helms are worn directly on the head.
mandatoryVisualRules.capeLow: Cape/mantle must drape LOW from shoulders, flowing downward — NOT rising behind the head or appearing as hair.
mandatoryVisualRules.culturalAuthenticity: Face and features must match the source culture of the faction.
mandatoryVisualRules.styleBaseline: Stylized but detailed — NOT photorealistic. Suitable for 3D model conversion. Premium dark mythological tactical RPG aesthetic.
mandatoryVisualRules.composition: Full-body playable deity concept, combat-ready stance, mobile-readable silhouette. No text, no logos, no UI overlay. One-deity-only composition.

canonUpdate: Playable characters are the actual gods and goddesses of the Mythos Gates universe. NOT Deities as a separate race, class, species, mortal champion, or type of character.

godsAreHeroes.rule: Every playable character is an actual god or goddess
godsAreHeroes.goal: This is an actual god who has entered the battlefield — NOT a fantasy warrior designed to look powerful

sections.20: One God at a Time — 17-step workflow with approval gate

finalCreativeStandard: Every playable character should make the player think: 'That's a GOD.' → 'I know exactly which god that is.' → 'I know what realm they come from.' → 'I know what faction they represent.' → 'I can see how the Mythos Gates are connected to their existence.' Every god should feel ancient. Every goddess should feel divine. Every faction should feel like a civilization. Every realm should feel like a real world. Every Gate should feel like it connects worlds that were never meant to be connected. And every character should look like they belong in Mythos Gates: Ascension.

actionCombatArtRules.combatRole: Each deity has a combat role (Bulwark, Fracture, Dominion, Fracture, Shadow, Range, Endurance, Counter) that must be visible in their silhouette and weapon design
actionCombatArtRules.abilityVisuals: Each deity's abilities must be visually distinctive — basic attacks, active abilities, signatures, and ultimates should each have unique visual signatures
actionCombatArtRules.elementExpression: Each deity's element (Solar, Storm, Thunder, Spirit, Nature, Holy, Shadow) must be visible in energy effects, particle colors, and material glow
actionCombatArtRules.ultimateTransformation: Each deity's ultimate/ascension form should be a visual transformation that makes the deity look fundamentally different and more powerful
actionCombatArtRules.mobileReadability: Strong silhouettes, clear telegraph lines, obvious AoE markers — the character must be readable at mobile screen size during fast action combat
